hints: “Immediately before” means the two plates must touch.
Join the two immediate links into one block of three plates. Keep their internal order.
Use the clue that says “before”, without “immediately”, to place one plate ahead of the block. Put the remaining plate after it, then read the five initials.

episode.story: The chart room has gone dark. One lamp still glows beside the compass. Beneath it lie five wooden plates, each naming a feature from the navigator’s coastal notes. Arrange them in the only order the clues allow. Then read the first letters from left to right: together they recover the bearing missing from the chart.
episode.title: The Last Bearing
